body:
## Summary

Preserve dplyr's function-factory evaluation when an unnamed local `across()` forwards its function through wrapper dots and enables dynamic unpacking. Keep the forwarded argument intact and read its cached type only when checking default names for FALSE unpacking.

Apply the required timing proposal by registering one existing test file in the start-first list; retain the existing relative order.

```diff
 across(.fns = ..n)
-  -> wrap .fns for name checks
+  -> let dplyr capture the original promise
+  -> read the cached argument for default-name checks
```

Closes #1170.

## Evidence

- **Before:** On main `3d631db7`, the reported TRUE and string-template cases return `4, 4` with one factory call; ordinary dplyr returns `5, 4` with two calls.
  **After:** Regression coverage compares values, factory calls and group-context events with ordinary dplyr, including FALSE unpacking, function lists, direct-function controls and parenthesized calls. Forwarded output-collision checks remain covered.
- Verification: [full at ba0f2c55 and priority-only source at 41ad3c5e](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1174#issuecomment-6602198443).
- Review: [Standards 0 findings; Spec 0 findings at 41ad3c5e](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1174#issuecomment-6602227990).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert the code and regression tests together; no persisted data or public API changes.

**Blast Radius:** summaries

Local unnamed `across()` summaries using forwarded function arguments and dynamic unpacking.
title: fix: preserve forwarded factories under dynamic unpacking
